summary.prose: The build gate stops assuming a Node project. A command profile, read once per build from the repository root's marker files and an optional repo setting, drives both the gate and the builder prompt. A Node project with no setting behaves exactly as today; other project types get their own guidance in the prompt, and either state their commands in a repo setting for an independent run or are told the gate ran nothing.

tasks.title: Add CommandProfile and project-type detection
tasks.summary: Add the CommandProfile type, InvalidCommandSetting error and a detector that reads root marker files (package.json, pyproject.toml/setup.py, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pom.xml/build.gradle/build.sbt) to give node, python, go, rust, jvm or unknown. Several markers of different types give unknown. Include the per-type guidance table used only for prompt text. The Node default reproduces today's TYPECHECK_ARGV, TEST_RUNNER_ARGV and TAP format. No behaviour change yet.
acceptanceChecks: A temp repo holding only package.json is detected as node, and likewise pyproject.toml python, go.mod go, Cargo.toml rust, pom.xml jvm
No marker or markers of different types give unknown
The Node default profile equals today's argv constants and tap format
The guidance table has an entry for every detected type including unknown, so the prompt can render all of them
Typecheck passes

The four route builders keep spreading basePlan.

tasks.title: Render prompts and Definition of done from the profile
tasks.summary: Replace the TYPECHECK_CMD and TEST_CMD literals in render.ts and the implement-task prompt slots with values from the profile and guidance table. A Node project keeps today's text; other types name their own commands; an unknown type is told to find and run the project's own typecheck and tests. The statement that the daemon already ran the checks is made only where the daemon ran them.

Wire the validate and implement phases to pass the profile to the plan and the prompt.

tasks.title: Test-file naming for a project with a repo setting (plan-level addition)
tasks.summary: Plan-level addition for the user to confirm at approval, not in the LLD: test-mapping refuses a case file not ending in .test.ts and the trivial plan's isTest keeps only .test.ts files in __tests__. For a plan with commandsSource 'repo-setting' and a non-Node type, accept any repo-relative file for a case and treat the project's own test files as tests, leaving the Node rules unchanged.
